title: Namespace Neighbour
subtitle: Break out of a pod service account in Kubernetes
summary: Planned lab: start from a low-privilege service account and escalate through over-permissive RBAC bindings to read a protected secret.
scenario: A cluster namespace grants list/watch on secrets to a builder account. Find the binding, use it, then tighten the role.
availabilityNote: Planned — requires a Kubernetes API server and cluster networking. Not available in this deployment.
